name: PIT-Avail
description: Point-in-time NBA player availability, 2021-22 to 2025-26: a game-level benchmark with a compliant pregame availability feature (official injury report at a fixed cutoff, timed by the printed report time) and leaky versions (post-game participation, whole-season statistics), plus summary tables. Player-level tables are rebuilt locally from public sources with the repository code; source documents are not redistributed.
citeAs: PIT-Avail: a point-in-time NBA player availability benchmark, version 1.0.0. Accompanies "Who Was Really Out? A Point-in-Time NBA Availability Benchmark, and What It Says About Hindsight" (under review). https://github.com/yangzhou-tysportsanalytics/nba-point-in-time-availability-benchmark
rai:dataCollection: Official NBA injury-report PDFs (league public URL, SHA-256 listed) and a CC0 Kaggle box-score dataset (version 515).
rai:dataLimitations: Rosters approximate (box appearances only in the public build); some games missing from the box-score source; no betting lines; leaky columns are post-game or look-ahead by construction and must not be used as pregame features.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Injury reasons published by the league about professional players; no private data added.

distribution.name: bench_games_public
distribution.description: Game-level benchmark, one row per game

recordSet.name: games
recordSet.description: Benchmark rows; evaluation: train 2023-24 and 2024-25, test 2025-26, exclude any_block_missing; headline metric RMSE(F1) - RMSE(F2) on margin

field.name: game_id
field.description: NBA game id

field.name: season_year
field.description: Season, labelled by the year it ends (2026 = 2025-26)

field.name: game_date_et
field.description: Game date, US Eastern (MM/DD/YYYY)

field.name: home
field.description: Home team (NBA abbreviation)

field.name: away
field.description: Away team (NBA abbreviation)

field.name: margin
field.description: Target: home points minus away points (final, overtime included)

field.name: any_block_missing
field.description: True if either team had no submitted report at the cutoff (excluded from the benchmark)

field.name: strength_diff
field.description: Pregame control: home minus away average margin over the previous 10 games

field.name: rest_diff
field.description: Pregame control: home minus away rest days (capped at 3)

field.name: n_out_pre_h
field.description: Home reference-rotation players reported Out at the cutoff (pregame)

field.name: n_out_pre_a
field.description: Away reference-rotation players reported Out at the cutoff (pregame)

field.name: n_out_real_h
field.description: Home reference-rotation players who did not play (POST-GAME; leakage)

field.name: n_out_real_a
field.description: Away reference-rotation players who did not play (POST-GAME; leakage)

field.name: F1_diff
field.description: Compliant: absence value of players reported Out at the cutoff, home minus away (efficiency points)

field.name: F2_diff
field.description: LEAKY (post-game): absence value of players who did not play, home minus away

field.name: F3_diff
field.description: LEAKY (look-ahead): F1 players valued with whole-season efficiency, home minus away

field.name: F4_diff
field.description: LEAKY (both): did-not-play players valued with whole-season efficiency, home minus away

field.name: status
field.description: Pregame status at the cutoff (Out, Doubtful, Questionable, Probable, Available, not_listed)

field.name: player_games
field.description: Roster player-games with this status, 2023-24 to 2025-26

field.name: played_pct
field.description: Percent of those player-games in which the player played

field.name: share_of_lost_ref_minutes_pct
field.description: Percent of reference minutes lost to absent rotation players that fall in this status
